descFull: BlueToolkit is an extensible Bluetooth Classic vulnerability testing framework that helps uncover new and old vulnerabilities in Bluetooth-enabled devices. Could be used in the vulnerability research, penetration testing and bluetooth hacking. We also collected and classified Bluetooth vulnerabilities in an "Awesome Bluetooth Security" way
